exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: What do you like to drink with your dinner? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you drink a lot of water every day? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you prefer drinking tea or coffee? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 5
exercises.prompt: If people visit you in your home, what do you usually offer them to drink? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a monument (e.g., a statue or sculpture) that you like. You should say: what this monument is where this monument is what it looks like and explain why you like this monument.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What kinds of monuments do tourists in your country enjoy visiting?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Why do you think there are often statues of famous people in public places?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that old monuments and buildings should always be preserved?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Why is architecture such a popular university subject?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 7
exercises.prompt: In what ways has the design of homes changed in recent years?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 8
exercises.prompt: To what extent does the design of buildings affect people’s moods?
